description:
£155 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the student market this spacious four-bedroom maisonette, located on St George's Terrace.

Situated in the heart of Jesmond, this fantastic property offers four generously sized double bedrooms, each benefiting from its own bathroom, making it an ideal choice for students seeking comfortable and convenient shared accommodation.

The property boasts a spacious living area, neutral décor throughout and a range of charming period features. The modern kitchen provides a practical space for everyday living, while the communal garden to the front offers an additional outdoor area to enjoy.

Perfectly positioned for student life, the property is within close proximity to West Jesmond Metro, Tesco and the popular bars and restaurants of Osborne Road. With excellent transport links and convenient access to the universities, the location is ideal for students.

Early viewing is highly recommended to avoid disappointment. To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our dedicated Lettings Team!
